open_decisions.title: Canonical Metis language version for Model 1
open_decisions.resolution: Ratified Metis language 0.43 from source commit a2dde2b191f6b78c2003d74875560da782470968; tooling package 0.23.87 is provenance, not the language version.

open_decisions.title: Held-out families and family criticality
open_decisions.resolution: Ratified six held-out families F-1 through F-6, their criticality and fail-closed leakage grouping from the pinned 197-file census. The first 30 source allocations are distinct and schema-validated; they remain unsealed until dependency closure, data-rights and task-specific oracle evidence are complete.

open_decisions.title: Final metric thresholds and statistical tolerances
Pinned mlx and mlx-vlm versions
open_decisions.resolution: Ratified CPython 3.12.10, MLX/MLX Metal 0.32.1 and MLX-VLM 0.6.15 with exact isolated dependency and model locks. The pinned Qwen3.8 27B 4-bit checkpoint passed strict load, deterministic generation, finite backward, 10/50/600 iterations, save/reload, observable adapter-on/off behavior and a bit-exact full-state 4-step versus 2-step-plus-resume comparison. Qualification is bounded to the public synthetic batch-1, sequence-128, rank-8, alpha-16, LR-1e-5, seed-17, dropout-0 path recorded in the W4 report; it does not authorize W5 or distribution.

open_decisions.title: Rank, alpha, learning rate and seed grid
open_decisions.resolution: Ratified before W5 candidate results: sequence 1024, batch/accumulation 1, dropout 0, completion-only Adam; four screening configurations from rank 8/16 with alpha fixed at 2x rank and LR 1e-5/2e-5, seed 17, at most 100 steps each. Select on dev semantic oracles only, then repeat one finalist with seeds 17/29/43 for at most 100 steps each; frozen data is never used for selection. Total cap is 700 optimizer steps, 18 hours and 32 GiB of published checkpoints. Public-synthetic probes passed at rank 8 step 1 and resume step 2 and rank 16 step 1 with finite loss and 94.43-95.04 GB peak Metal. Peak above 110 GB, OOM/NaN, identity/checkpoint failure or any semantic critical veto stops the run. O-003 and W1/W3 data gates still independently block W5.

open_decisions.title: Local artifact-store format
open_decisions.resolution: Ratified local-only artifacts/w5/<run-id> layout with immutable source/compiler/runtime/model/dataset/split/config/prompt/oracle/adapter identities, SHA-256 payload manifests, fsync plus atomic rename, verification before resume/evaluation, no symlinks and no automatic deletion of published artifacts. Every run is capped at 40 GiB excluding the shared base, must start with at least 100 GiB free and preserve a 60 GiB reserve. The 2026-08-20 measurement observed 555920019456 bytes free, 30121988096 bytes of existing artifacts and a 935497728-byte full-state checkpoint. Cleanup requires explicit operator action after the frontier verdict is durably recorded.
